newsitem.title: USA: CleveTrust to make third liquidation payment.
newsitem.headline: CleveTrust to make third liquidation payment.

text.p: CleveTrust Realty Investors said Monday it will make a liquidation distribution of $2.10 per share following the sale of three buildings.
The company said in a statement it will make the payment on August 19 to shareholders of record on August 12.
It said the payment was the third to date, bringing the total amount to $5.70 per share.

CleveTrust said the payment comes from the sale of the Office Alpha Building in Dallas, Texas, the 14800 Quorum Building in Dallas, Texas and the Brookside Office Building in Arlington, Texas for a combined $17.9 million, resulting in a gain of about $5.2 million.
